words.zh: n. 孔子
words.example: Confucius is regarded as one of the greatest teachers in Chinese history.

words.zh: n. 官邸，巨宅，公馆
words.example: The ancient mansion on the hill attracts many visitors every year.

words.zh: n. 公墓；墓地
words.example: The old cemetery behind the church contains graves from the eighteenth century.

words.zh: n. 哲学，哲学体系；哲学思想；生活信条（或态度）；人生观
words.example: Her philosophy of life was shaped by ancient Chinese thinkers.

words.zh: n. 后代，后裔；派生物
words.example: He is a direct descendant of a famous general in the Tang Dynasty.

words.zh: n. 个人；独立的个体；  adj. 个人的；个别的；独特的；单独的；【化】单个的（分子、原子）
words.example: Every individual has the right to learn about his or her history.

words.zh: n. （鞋、袜子、脚）后跟；足跟；脚跟；  v. 修理后跟；倾侧
words.example: The heel of this old shoe was worn down after years of walking.

words.zh: n. 王国；领域；【生】界
words.example: The kingdom was united under one ruler after a long war.

words.zh: n. 负责人，老板；首领，酋长；长官；  adj. 主要的；首席的，最高级别的；最重要的
words.example: The chief reason for the battle was control of the port.

words.zh: n. 拼图；谜，智力游戏；疑问；难题；  v. 使迷惑，迷惑
words.example: Historians still puzzle over how the ancient stones were moved.

words.zh: adj. 附近的，邻近的；  adv. 在附近
words.example: A nearby village preserves many traditions from the Ming Dynasty.

words.zh: phr. 把……和……连接或联结起来
words.example: A stone bridge joins the island to the mainland.

words.zh: phr. 脱离……
words.example: The southern states tried to break away from the union.

words.zh: v. 属于，附属；归属；应在（某处）；适应；是……的成员
words.example: These ancient artefacts belong in a national museum.

words.zh: phr. 属于
words.example: The castle and its lands belong to the royal family.

words.zh: conj. 也，和，还；…以及…
words.example: The tour covers the city wall as well as the royal garden.

words.zh: n. 货币；流通；流行
words.example: The new currency was introduced after the country became independent.

words.zh: n. 军队；武装力量；  adj. 军事的；军队的
words.example: The military built a fortress to defend the northern border.

words.zh: n. 防御，防务，辩护；防御物；答辩；[pl.]防御工事；防守队员，后卫；守方
words.example: The high walls were built for the defence of the kingdom.

words.zh: adj. 合法的，法定的，法律的
words.example: The new law made it legal to trade with neighbouring countries.

words.zh: v. 围绕；  vt. 包围；  n. 围绕物；  adj. 环绕立体声的
words.example: Tall trees surround the ancient temple and create a peaceful atmosphere.

words.zh: v. 证明；  n. 证据，证明；证物；证词；【化】证据，依据
words.example: The coins provide clear evidence of trade between the two regions.

words.zh: n. 位置，地点；定位；外景拍摄地；【化】位置；【数】位置
words.example: The map shows the exact location of the buried treasure.

words.zh: v. 征服，攻克；破除；克服；改正（恶习等）
words.example: The army hoped to conquer the neighbouring kingdom in one year.

words.zh: n. 战役，战斗；斗争；冲突；较量；竞争；  v. 较量，搏斗；奋斗
words.example: The famous battle changed the course of the country's history.

words.zh: n. 舷窗；舱门；港口城市；葡萄酒；港，港口，口岸；码头；机场；【计】端口
words.example: Ships from many countries unload their goods at this busy port.

words.zh: adj. 迷人的，有极大吸引力的
words.example: The museum tells a fascinating story about the rise and fall of the empire.

words.zh: phr. 留心；留意
words.example: Keep your eyes open for ancient coins while walking along the beach.

words.zh: v. 充电，充值；收费；控告；向…...冲去；要价；指控；使承担责任；【航】充电；  n. 费用；主管；掌管；控告；负责；指控；收费；充电，电量；职责；【财】抵押品，抵押；【法】担保物权；带球撞人（一种违例动作）
words.example: The tour guide charged us a small fee for visiting the castle.

words.zh: vt. 宣布；预示；  vi. 作播音员，宣布竞选；  v. 显示
words.example: The government will announce the new historical park's opening date tomorrow.

words.zh: v. 总计；发展成，变成；  n. 数量；金额；数额；【化】总量，总额
words.example: The donations amounted to over ten thousand yuan.

words.zh: n. 美术馆，画廊；旁听席，边座
words.example: The museum's new gallery displays paintings from the ancient Roman period.

words.zh: v. 靠近；接近；走近；接洽；着手处理；【航】接近；  n. 接近；途径；方法；态度；【化】方法
words.example: As we approached the old castle, we could feel its history.

words.zh: vt. 确保；保证
words.example: Regular practice ensures that you can perform well in the concert.

words.zh: n. 风景，景观；风景画；横向打印格式；形势；地貌，地形；  vt. 美化……的环境
words.example: The beautiful landscape of the countryside inspired many local poets.

words.zh: adj. 慷慨大方的；充裕的，宽厚的；丰富的；无私的；大量的
words.example: The generous donation helped restore the historic town library.

words.zh: n. 黄油，奶油；奉承话；水果酱，干果酱；  v. 涂黄油于……上；讨好
words.example: She spread butter on the fresh bread while preparing breakfast.

words.zh: n. 蜜，蜂蜜；亲爱的，宝贝（爱称）
words.example: The local honey tastes sweet and reminds me of summer flowers.

words.zh: n. 祖宗；祖先；原型；先驱
words.example: Our ancestors built this village hundreds of years ago.

words.zh: v. 安置；  n. 位置；姿势；职位；名次；观点；处置；立场；方位；地位；位置（男女团官方设定的团体担当位置）；职位，岗位；状况、态度或立场；【化】位置；地方
words.example: The guide positioned the tourists near the entrance to see the artwork.

words.zh: n. 院子；天井
words.example: The old school courtyard is a quiet place for reading and relaxation.

words.zh: n. 零食，小吃，快餐；点心；  v. （在正餐之间）吃零食；吃零嘴
words.example: We had a quick snack before the afternoon history class began.

words.zh: adj. 热切的，渴望的，急不可耐的
words.example: The students were eager to learn about traditional Irish music.

words.zh: n. 诗人
words.example: The famous poet wrote many verses about the Scottish landscape.

words.zh: n. <英>郡，<美>县
words.example: Our county will hold a festival to celebrate its history and traditions.

words.zh: n. 盛宴，特别的享受；筵席；节日；  v. 尽情地吃
words.example: After the harvest, the villagers prepared a great feast for everyone.

words.zh: v. 滚动，转动；使翻转；卷；使摇摆；使平坦，压平；使成筒形(球形)；【数】滚动，掷（骰子）；  n. 卷，卷状物；翻滚；面包卷
words.example: The baker rolled the dough into a perfect round shape.

words.zh: n. 点，圆点；点（在域名里起分隔作用）；  v. 做小点记号；点缀；遍布，布满
words.example: Small white dots on the map show the locations of ancient ruins.

words.zh: n. （总称）牛，牲口
words.example: The cattle graze peacefully in the green fields near the river.

words.zh: n. 吼叫声，轰鸣声；喧闹；咆哮，吼叫；  vi. 吼叫；咆哮；哄笑，大笑；喧闹；  v. 大声呼喊；使轰鸣
words.example: The roar of the crowd filled the stadium during the final match.

words.zh: n. 海洋，洋，大海；许多，大量
words.example: The Atlantic Ocean has shaped the history and weather of this region.

words.zh: n. 气味；香味；迹象；  v. 嗅到；察觉
words.example: The scent of old books filled the quiet library corridor.

words.zh: v. 问候，招呼；对……作出反应
words.example: Traditional music greets every visitor at the entrance to the festival.

words.zh: n. 酒吧，酒馆
words.example: The old pub near the castle serves traditional local food and beer.

words.zh: n. 葡萄酒；果酒；  vi. 喝酒；  vt. 请...喝酒
words.example: The region is famous for producing fine wine from local grapes.

words.zh: n. 啤酒
words.example: They stopped at a small pub to taste the local beer.

words.zh: v. 炖，焖；使焦虑不安；受闷热；  n. 炖肉（或菜）；鱼塘；炖肉块
words.example: My grandmother makes a delicious beef stew for cold winter evenings.

words.zh: n. 风俗；习惯；传统；  adj. 定制的
words.example: Every region has its own custom for celebrating the harvest.

words.zh: adj. 知觉的，感官的；感觉的；【财】感觉的，感官的
words.example: The museum offers a sensory experience of traditional village life.

words.zh: adj. 吸引人的，容貌出众的；突出的，惊人的，异常的；显著的，突出的；  n. 罢工
words.example: The striking contrast between old and new buildings attracts many visitors.

words.zh: n. 转变；过渡时期；  v. 过渡；转变
words.example: The transition from school to university can be exciting and challenging.

words.zh: n. 成就；实现；达到；完成
words.example: Winning the music competition was a great achievement for the team.

words.zh: n. 人群，观众；民众；朋友；一伙人；  v. 聚集在……周围；涌入（脑海）；挤满
words.example: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the historical parade.

words.zh: n. 威尔士（英国大不列颠岛西南部地区）
words.example: Wales is known for its beautiful coastlines and ancient castles.

words.zh: n. 苏格兰
words.example: Scotland has a rich tradition of music, poetry, and Highland games.

words.zh: n. 北爱尔兰（英）
words.example: Northern Ireland is famous for its dramatic coastline and friendly people.

words.zh: adj. 罗马的，罗马文字的，罗马人的；  n. 罗马天主教的；古罗马人
words.example: The Roman road still lies beneath the modern town centre.

words.zh: adj. 爱尔兰的，爱尔兰人的，爱尔兰语的；  n. 爱尔兰人，爱尔兰语
words.example: Irish folk songs often tell stories about history and daily life.
